annotation.title_clean: PL n. 897/2024 - Dispõe sobre a Autenticação de Mídia Digital criada ou modificada por Inteligência Artificial (IA) e dá outras providências
annotation.title_en: Bill No. 897/2024 - On the Authentication of Digital Media Created or Modified by Artificial Intelligence (AI)
annotation.authors_or_issuer: Câmara dos Deputados (Dep. Saullo Vianna, União/AM)
annotation.summary_en: Brazilian Chamber of Deputies bill requiring clear, visible marking and automated authentication of all digital media generated or modified by AI, making platforms responsible for ensuring authenticity, with unspecified competent bodies enforcing and applying sanctions. It aims to curb disinformation and protect democracy.
key_provisions_or_claims: Mandatory authentication of all AI-generated or AI-modified digital media
Clear, visible marking indicating origin and authenticity
Marking and verification done automatically via authenticity-recognition algorithms
Digital platforms must implement mechanisms ensuring authenticity of AI media
Competent bodies may inspect and apply sanctions; effective on publication
